brief:
Israeli forces and settlers stormed multiple villages across the occupied West Bank on Friday, the Wafa news agency reported. Hundreds of settlers participated in the incursions, which included attacks on Palestinians in the affected areas. The raids targeted several locations throughout the territory.

The operation involved both military personnel and civilian settlers acting in coordination, according to the reporting. Wafa documented the assaults as part of a broader pattern of incursions across the West Bank. The scale of participation by settlers underscored the organized nature of the Friday operations.
